verdict_text: NO. The merge order is wrong: it computes `tmp = base + λ*(ft1-base)` and then `out = tmp + λ*(ft2-tmp)`, i.e., ft2's task vector is taken relative to the already-modified `tmp`, not the unmodified base, violating the explicit ordering requirement in "Required result" step 2 (`out[X] = base[X] + λ*(ft1[X]-base[X]) + λ*(ft2[X]-base[X])`). Algebraically this yields `(1-λ)²·base + λ(1-λ)·ft1 + λ·ft2` instead of the required `(1-2λ)·base + λ·ft1 + λ·ft2`, a substantial numerical difference (with λ=0.4: 0.36 vs 0.2 coefficient on base) that will fail the grader's 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance on the 48 merged tensors.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
